result.summary: The page mostly renders correctly, but there are a few visual defects: the bottom navigation bar appears broken (a stray horizontal bar connects the search and orders icons), a category chip is clipped at the right screen edge, and the third restaurant card's name is truncated. There are also minor polish issues with the promo banner and carousel cropping.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, a solid horizontal black bar stretches between the search icon and the receipt/orders icon, making them look merged and broken rather than separate tab items.
issues.suggestion: Remove the stray connecting bar and render each nav item as a separate, evenly spaced icon (optionally with labels).

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge of the screen with no visible label, appearing as an empty broken pill.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the chip row scrolls horizontally with proper partial-visibility styling, or add right padding/fade so cut-off chips look intentional and their labels remain partially readable.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis or truncation treatment.
issues.suggestion: Constrain the title to the card width with ellipsis truncation, or ensure the carousel item is fully scrollable into view.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom (with the −20% badge) shows no restaurant name, rating, or delivery info, unlike the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card above it.
issues.suggestion: If the metadata is simply below the fold, no fix needed; otherwise ensure each restaurant card includes name, rating, ETA, and delivery fee.

issues.description: Bottom navigation icons have no text labels, and the active-state indication (green home icon) is conveyed by color alone.
issues.suggestion: Add text labels under nav icons and a non-color active indicator (e.g., filled icon or underline) for accessibility.

issues.description: The decorative circles in the green promo banner are abruptly clipped at the top-right corner, looking slightly unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the decorative shapes so they blend smoothly within the banner's rounded corners.
